feedback.message: Effect commit must revalidate scoped decision dependencies plus capability generation/epoch, resource generation/identity, budget and external authorization. Model output and Needle route remain non-authoritative.

Runtime ABI should carry dependency-version witnesses and generational resource handles. Local idempotency does not establish exactly-once external effects; expose remote idempotency/transaction/reconciliation or UNCERTAIN.

Executable H-WP-10 oracle reproduces the dependency-envelope advantage in a related synthetic model: 32 exhaustive and 100k fuzz cases show 0 unsafe/0 false abort for scoped validation. This is implementation convergence, not independent replication.
Persist exact dependency versions, capability generation/epoch, resource generation/identity, idempotency identity, approval witness and UNCERTAIN external-effect outcomes as authoritative receipts.
Workspace selection/uptake/re-entry may influence decision formation but cannot mint or refresh effect authority.
Activation/topology may be a declared decision dependency; activation itself is not an authority witness.
Alternative/proposal identity must survive recurrence without casting into authority; commit uses explicit runtime witnesses.
Emergent integration measurements remain observational and cannot authorize effects.

Add scoped freshness, capability/resource generation ABA, budget shrink, irreversible external approval and external-effect recovery uncertainty cases to H1/H2/H3 differential suites and TurnTraceEnvelope receipts.

rule: Feedback is architectural/test guidance only. No branch receives authority to mutate Frank's own Harness from Frank-originated self-proposals.
